description: Every collaborative post this Instagram account is a co-author on — who posted it, and the COMBINED engagement across all co-authors (total likes and comments, plus saves, shares and reposts where Instagram provides them). Read-only, free.

account.description: which Instagram account — @handle or id; omit for the one Page-linked account

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

pageId.description: Facebook Page id — omit when only one Page is connected

name: list_instagram_collab_media
title: Posts this account co-authors
